label: D1 after a reward, late in the episode, when the agent is about to choose a2
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1 (previous trial rewarded). Every activation (11898 of 11899 dev) falls on a trial where the agent goes on to choose a2, and almost all are in trials 60-99 of the episode (67% of mass in 90-99, none before trial 40). This tracks the low-value regime (value < 5.22 holds 77% of mass), so it looks like an episode-clock signal. The predicate uses the agent own upcoming choice (action at D1), which counts as a FUTURE variable but is something the agent computes. The closest fully-observed version swaps in prev_action != 1 (the previous choice was a2, and the agent almost always stays) and scores dev F1 0.51 vs 0.56 at the same ep_trial >= 80 cutoff. Adding good != 1 helps a little (most mass is when S2 is good) but is left out for simplicity. Precision is limited: many rewarded late D1 steps before an a2 choice stay silent. Magnitude: the largest activations (about 1.0) come on the first reward after an unrewarded trial. During runs of consecutive rewards it settles to about 0.2-0.4 and creeps up across the run. It never fires at GO or D2, after no reward, or before an a1 choice.
